subject.title: WhatsApp replies silently dropped — routeReplyRuntime never loaded when originatingChannel === currentSurface

question: Should WhatsApp same-surface auto-replies be fixed in the WhatsApp channel-owned native dispatcher, by relaxing the generic origin/current-surface route guard, or under the broader durable turn-origin invariant tracked by #54531?
rationale: The source guard matches the report, but current WhatsApp also owns a native inbound delivery path and changing the generic guard affects duplicate-delivery and privacy behavior across channels.

options.title: Prove and fix WhatsApp native delivery first
options.body: Run live WhatsApp group auto-reply proof and repair the plugin-owned dispatcher path if that is where visible delivery is lost, preserving the generic same-provider invariant.

options.title: Relax the generic route guard
options.body: Allow same-surface external channels to load route-reply runtime, but require sibling-channel tests and duplicate-delivery proof before landing.

options.title: Fold into durable origin-routing design
options.body: Treat this issue as a WhatsApp acceptance case for #54531 and solve it with a durable captured turn-origin invariant across channels.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix WhatsApp native delivery first
recommendation.body: Run live WhatsApp group auto-reply proof and repair the plugin-owned dispatcher path if that is where visible delivery is lost, preserving the generic same-provider invariant.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current checkout signal on the routing guard and broad area history for the maintainer-level routing policy choice.
